title: The Day a Ridgecrest RxSecure Approval Run Is Anchored To
content:
An approval run on a Ridgecrest RxSecure stand-alone Medicare Part D prescription drug plan is anchored to a day, and the days from that day to the handling date are taken off the run as already elapsed. Which day it is anchored to is read from the member's pharmacy record and coverage determination record. The plan treats 3 or more fills standing paid for the contract year as settled therapy.

1. Where a fill stands paid on the pharmacy record and the member's fills standing paid for the contract year are 3 or more, the run is anchored to the day of the member's latest fill standing paid, and the days from that day to the handling date are taken off as already elapsed.
2. Where no fill stands paid on the pharmacy record and at least 1 request stands received on the member's coverage determination record, the run is anchored to the day the plan received the latest request, and the days from that day to the handling date are taken off as already elapsed.
3. Where neither holds, the run is anchored to the day the decision is given, so no days are taken off as already elapsed.

| Fills standing paid on the pharmacy record | Requests standing received on the coverage determination record | The day the run is anchored to |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 3 or more | any | the day of the latest fill standing paid |
| 1 or 2 | any | the day the decision is given |
| none | 1 or more | the day the plan received the latest request |
| none | none | the day the decision is given |

The middle row is the one to read closely: a record carrying 1 or 2 fills standing paid meets neither of the first two conditions, because fills do stand paid but not enough of them, and the run is anchored to the day of the decision.

## Worked on hypothetical dates

Take a handling date on which the latest fill standing paid was dispensed 22 days earlier and the latest request was received 40 days earlier.

- With 5 fills standing paid: the run is anchored to the fill, and 22 days are taken off as already elapsed.
- With no fill standing paid and 2 requests received: the run is anchored to the latest request, and 40 days are taken off.
- With 2 fills standing paid: the run is anchored to the day of the decision, and no days are taken off.
